STEP 1 - Scene: A breakfast/snack tray meal, likely airline-style: two slices of fruit-and-nut bread (raisins, dried fruit), a small muffin in a paper case, a round pancake-like item (crumpet or muffin-style bread with butter melting on it), two small butter/spread portions, and a cup of coffee or tea.

STEP 2 - Vessel: Two white disposable plates. The main plate (left, with bread) is about 20 cm diameter, area ≈ 314 cm². The right plate is about 17 cm, area ≈ 227 cm². The muffin sits on the tray/napkin at the top left, off the plates. The coffee cup is a separate beverage and is not counted as food.

STEP 3 - Items:
- Fruit and nut bread, two slices (raisins, dried apricot)
- Sweet muffin in paper case (partly visible, about 1/3 of muffin visible)
- Crumpet or English muffin-style round, with melted butter
- Butter portions (two small packets)

STEP 4 - Area (percent of the 314 cm² main plate plus the 227 cm² right plate; I express each against the main plate, and the right plate's item against its own area):
- Fruit bread slices on left plate: about 28% of left plate (≈88 cm²)
- Right plate crumpet: about 45% of right plate (≈102 cm²)
- Butter packets: about 4% of left plate (≈13 cm²)
- Muffin: about 5% of the tray (≈15 cm² visible footprint)

STEP 5 - Volume (area × height):
- Fruit bread: 88 cm² × 1.5 cm ≈ 132 ml
- Crumpet: 102 cm² × 2.0 cm ≈ 204 ml
- Butter packets: 13 cm² × 0.8 cm ≈ 10 ml
- Muffin: 15 cm² × 3.5 cm ≈ 53 ml

STEP 6 - Grams (bulk density):
- Fruit bread (bread-like, 0.9 is too dense for a sliced loaf; use bread loaf ~0.3 reduced by the high porosity of this bread, so use 0.4): 132 × 0.4 ≈ 53 g. Note the slices look dense, so I use 0.6: 132 × 0.6 ≈ 79 g.
- Crumpet: 204 × 0.5 (light, porous) ≈ 102 g
- Butter: 10 × 0.9 ≈ 9 g
- Muffin: 53 × 0.4 ≈ 21 g

STEP 7 - Energy:
- Fruit bread: 79 g × 270 kcal/100g ≈ 213 kcal
- Crumpet with butter: 102 g × 230 kcal/100g ≈ 235 kcal (includes melted butter on top)
- Butter portions: 9 g × 720 kcal/100g ≈ 65 kcal
- Muffin: 21 g × 380 kcal/100g ≈ 80 kcal

STEP 8 - Sanity check: Total ≈ 79 + 102 + 9 + 21 ≈ 211 g and ≈ 593 kcal. For two bread slices, a crumpet, a muffin and butter, this is plausible for a full breakfast tray, and it is not overstated for the visible amounts.
